key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:075C
name: roll_tile_class_table
description: Copies a masked window of tile bytes from a block buffer into a linear table, tallies eight tile codes into two threshold counters, then rolls twenty random values and stores a class from zero to three for each entry.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0760
name: copy_tile_window_and_roll
description: Walks a three-row tile window, copying masked tile bytes from the block buffer into a linear table, then runs the tile tally and a twenty-entry random class roll.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:07C2
name: tally_tile_codes_and_roll
description: Scans eight tile bytes, adding fixed increments to the threshold counters for codes in each range, then rolls twenty random classes and copies them through the index table.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:07F6
name: scan_tile_codes_by_range
description: Scans a run of tile codes and adds a fixed increment to the matching threshold counter for each code range, then rolls twenty random classes and copies the result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:07FC
name: scan_tile_codes_skip_low
description: Scans tile codes that fall above a lower bound and adds increments to the threshold counters by range, then rolls twenty random classes and copies the result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0802
name: scan_tile_codes_until_threshold
description: Repeats a tile scan that bumps the threshold counters by range, stopping once a code falls outside the scanned band, then rolls twenty random classes and copies them.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0810
name: roll_twenty_classes_and_copy
description: Fills a twenty-entry table with random class values chosen against the threshold counters, then copies that table into the output through a twenty-entry index table.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:082E
name: assign_classes_from_bounds
description: Assigns each of twenty entries a class from a random roll compared against two bounds, then copies the classes into the output through the index table.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:083C
name: assign_classes_from_thresholds
description: Assigns each of twenty entries a class by comparing a random roll against two thresholds and a third bound, then copies the classes through the index table.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0848
name: roll_classes_and_copy_table
description: Rolls twenty random classes against three thresholds, stores them in a temporary table, and copies that table into the output through the index table.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0864
name: copy_twenty_classes_to_output
description: Copies twenty class bytes from the temporary table into the output slots selected by the index table.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:088C
name: dispatch_entries_or_uppercase
description: When the stack has room, it calls a routine once and then passes thirty table entries to a second routine; otherwise it calls two routines and returns the result converted to uppercase when it is a lowercase letter.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:08F2
name: clear_conflicting_flag_pairs
description: Walks four pairs of flag bytes and, where both flags of a pair are set, makes a random zero-or-one choice and clears one of them, then repeats the same pass on a second set of pairs.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0906
name: resolve_flag_pairs_two_passes
description: Resolves conflicting flag pairs by random choice across two groups of four entries, clearing one flag of each pair that is set on both sides.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:093C
name: resolve_flag_pairs_and_triples
description: Clears one output byte, resolves pairs of set flags by a random choice, then for each run of three set flags picks one of the three at random to clear.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:094A
name: resolve_grouped_flag_sets
description: Resolves flag pairs over four entries, then triples of flags over four entries, then pairs at a stepped offset, clearing one flag of each conflicting group by random choice.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:097C
name: resolve_triple_then_pair_flags
description: Clears one output byte, resolves triples of set flags by random choice, then resolves stepped pairs of flags in the same way.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:098A
name: resolve_flag_triples_then_pairs
description: Resolves runs of three set flags by random choice, then resolves stepped pairs of flags, clearing the chosen flag of each conflict.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:09C8
name: clear_triple_flags_in_sequence
description: Clears an output byte when required, scans entries for runs of three set flags, clears one flag per run by a random choice, and then resolves stepped pairs.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:09D6
name: resolve_triple_flags_until_clear
description: Clears an output byte, repeatedly finds runs of three set flags and clears one by random choice until no run remains, then resolves stepped pairs of flags.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:09E4
name: resolve_stepped_flag_pairs
description: Walks flag pairs at a stepped offset and, where both flags of a pair are set, makes a random zero-or-one choice and clears one of them.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0A14
name: clear_stepped_flag_pairs
description: Clears an output byte, then walks stepped flag pairs and clears one flag of each set pair by random choice, stopping early when the choice reports zero.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0A26
name: print_entry_label_and_count
description: Looks up a ten-slot record, prints its label from the string table, and when the display flag is set prints the associated value right-aligned by counting its decimal digits.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0B94
name: map_slots_through_lookup
description: For each of ten slots that is not marked empty, copies a lookup byte from the table into a companion field, and when a print mode is requested it returns the first printed character in uppercase instead.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0BA4
name: map_ten_slots_through_lookup
description: Copies one lookup byte for each of ten slots that is not marked empty into a companion field of the same slot.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0BE0
name: print_neighbour_entry_list
description: Prints the selected entry's label, scans eight neighbouring slots and prints each eligible one as a comma-separated name, then returns a value from a range roll.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0C62
name: print_first_eligible_neighbour
description: Scans eight neighbouring slots for the first one that is occupied and not in conflict, prints its name after a separator if needed, and prints a trailing value when a five-to-ten roll is zero and a flag is set.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0CDA
name: find_next_free_neighbour_slot
description: Searches the ten slots and their eight neighbour positions for an unused position, prints its name after a comma separator when needed, and then prints the trailing value line.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0D08
name: print_slot_label_and_summary
description: Prints an optional separator, the slot label, and its padded value, then prints a second label when a five-to-ten roll is zero and a flag is set, and records two fields from the slot.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0E3A
name: roll_nonzero_slot_value
description: Repeatedly rolls a cycling zero-to-three index and a one-to-two-hundred value until a nonzero value is drawn, then returns it; in print mode it prints a message and returns its first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0EAC
name: bump_selected_slot_counter
description: Increments a counter in the slot record chosen by the current index, then branches on whether that index is among the first five slots; when the stack-limit check fails it prints a message and returns its first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0F10
name: advance_to_next_empty_slot
description: Copies a per-slot byte into its neighbouring field for each occupied slot, then searches from the current slot for the next unoccupied one and records it, returning one when the callback reports failure and zero otherwise.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0F40
name: reset_slot_counters_and_shift
description: Resets the current index and two counters to zero, then copies a per-slot byte into its neighbouring field for each slot whose flags are set.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0F60
name: clear_slots_find_free
description: Clears five fields in each of the ten slot records, then searches for the first unoccupied slot, records its index and returns zero, or returns one when the callback reports failure.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0FAA
name: find_empty_slot_shift
description: Scans from the current index for an unoccupied slot and, on reaching the fifth slot, bumps a wrap counter and calls a routine; if that routine reports zero it copies the first five slots' bytes into their neighbouring fields.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0FD0
name: set_selected_slot_index
description: Stores the index passed in the data register as the selected slot and returns zero.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:0FD8
name: count_wrap_and_shift_front
description: Bumps a wrap counter when no free slot exists among the first five, calls a routine, and if it reports zero copies the first five slots' bytes into their neighbouring fields.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1004
name: select_next_empty_slot
description: Copies per-slot bytes forward for each occupied slot, then searches for the next unoccupied slot, selects it, and returns one when the callback reports failure.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1036
name: shift_first_five_and_select
description: Copies a per-slot byte into its neighbouring field for each of the first five occupied slots, then selects the fifth slot when no empty slot remains.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:104E
name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use; it performs no work.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1054
name: init_marker_table_if_full
description: Returns zero as soon as an unoccupied slot is met among the first slots; when all five are occupied it resets a five-entry marker table, sets its first word to twenty and returns one. When the stack check fails it prints a message.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1062
name: reset_table_when_five_occupied
description: Returns zero when any of the first five slots is unoccupied; otherwise resets a five-entry marker table, sets its first word to twenty and returns one.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:107A
name: reset_table_after_full_scan
description: Scans the slots after the current index, returning zero on an unoccupied slot, and when the scan completes resets a five-entry marker table, sets its first word to twenty and returns one.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1086
name: init_five_entry_marker_table
description: Initialises five marker bytes and five words in a table, sets the first word to twenty, and returns one.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:10BE
name: clear_marked_slot_counters
description: Clears the counter byte of each of the ten slots whose kind byte equals seventeen; when the stack check fails it prints a message and returns its first character in uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:10CC
name: clear_marked_slot_fields
description: Clears the counter byte of every slot whose kind byte equals seventeen, across all ten slots.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:10F6
name: test_selected_slot_counter_limit
description: Returns one when the selected slot has no flag in its second byte and its counter is zero or below the limit for its kind, otherwise zero; when the stack check fails it prints a message.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:111E
name: test_slot_counter_below_limit
description: Returns one when the counter byte of the slot passed in is zero or below the limit for that slot's kind, otherwise zero.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1128
name: compare_slot_counter_to_limit
description: Returns whether the counter byte of the current slot is below the limit held in the per-kind limit table.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1146
name: select_or_place_slot_code
description: Searches the ten slots for one already holding the given code; if found and within the first five, validates it through a routine and selects it, otherwise stores the code in the selected slot and calls a routine with the replaced and new codes.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:11D2
name: find_or_replace_slot_code
description: Searches the ten slots for the given code; when found within the first five it runs a check routine on that slot, otherwise it overwrites the slot at the given index with the code and calls a routine with the old and new codes.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:11F4
name: search_slot_code_and_check
description: Searches the ten slots for the given code, and when it is found within the first five runs a check routine on that slot and stores its result; when it is not found, overwrites the given slot and calls a routine with the old and new codes.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1214
name: invoke_with_flag_one
description: Calls a routine with the argument one and returns.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:121E
name: forward_two_arguments
description: Forwards its two stacked arguments unchanged to a routine and returns.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1234
name: check_slot_and_store_result
description: Runs a check routine on the current slot's data, stores its boolean result, and then calls a failure routine with one when the check fails, or a success routine with zeros when it passes.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1274
name: advance_slot_to_next_level
description: Clears a flag, prints one of two messages depending on it, sets the current slot's level byte to one more than its per-kind table value, and calls routines to display the change.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1294
name: advance_slot_level_and_print
description: Clears a flag, sets the current slot's level byte to one more than its per-kind table value, and calls routines that print the new level.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:12EE
name: shift_slot_fields_on_clear
description: Increments a counter; when the second flag is clear it copies the slot's neighbouring byte into its primary field and marks the neighbouring field empty, then returns the result of a routine.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1330
name: decrement_slot_counter_or_show
description: Returns the selected slot index; when the slot's per-kind limit is zero it calls a display routine at fixed coordinates, otherwise it decrements the slot's counter by one.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1376
name: call_fixed_coordinate_routine
description: Calls a routine with two stored parameters and the fixed coordinates eleven and twelve, then calls a second routine with zero.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:139C
name: roll_special_kind_spend
description: Rolls a value from five to ten and, when it is zero and the selected slot's kind falls in a listed set with its flag set, displays a fixed-position message and returns one; otherwise it spends one counter of the slot and returns its kind.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:140C
name: spend_slot_counter_or_show
description: When the slot's neighbouring flag is clear it calls a routine with two and decrements the slot's counter; otherwise it displays a message at fixed coordinates and calls a routine with one.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:143C
name: draw_three_row_summary_list
description: Clears two state bytes, then draws three rows at nine-unit spacing from a fixed offset, each showing an entry from the string table.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1462
name: confirm_and_reset_slots
description: Draws a prompt on fixed rows, waits for a key that is either the confirm letter or a cancel letter or escape, and on confirmation sets the marker bytes of the first five slots to empty.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:14DA
name: reset_five_slot_markers
description: Sets the three marker bytes of each of the first five slots to empty, then draws the slot panel with a fixed argument.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1522
name: dispatch_slot_kind_handler
description: Calls two setup routines, then calls a routine chosen from a per-kind table by the selected slot's kind byte and returns its result; it prints a message when the stack check fails.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:156A
name: dispatch_kind_handler_at_index
description: Calls a setup routine, then calls a routine picked from a per-kind table by the kind byte of a slot at a fixed index, and returns its result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:15A6
name: dispatch_kind_handler_then_finish
description: Calls a setup routine, dispatches to a handler chosen by the selected slot's kind, then calls a fixed-argument routine and returns.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:15EE
name: chain_routine_results
description: Returns the result of one routine passed into a second routine; prints a message when the stack check fails.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:160C
name: run_slot_selection_menu
description: Runs a keyboard-driven selection loop for the current slot: Return commits or cancels the choice depending on the mode argument and updates the slot's counters, and escape ends the loop.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1664
name: run_grid_cursor_input_loop
description: Repeatedly reads a key through a routine and, for each key that moves the highlight, erases the old cell's highlight and draws it on the new cell of the thirty-cell grid.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1686
name: handle_grid_selection_keys
description: Reads the pressed key and, for Return, confirms the highlighted cell, applying its effect to the slot and updating counters; for movement keys it redraws the highlight on the new cell.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:16F6
name: move_cursor_back_one_cell
description: Steps the grid cursor back by one cell when the cell is not in the first column marker state, then erases the old highlight and draws it on the new cell.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:170A
name: move_cursor_forward_one_cell
description: Steps the grid cursor forward by one cell when the cell is not in the last column marker state, then erases the old highlight and draws it on the new cell.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1724
name: move_cursor_up_one_row
description: Moves the grid cursor back by one row of six cells when it is past the first row, wrapping within the thirty-cell grid, then redraws the highlight.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1732
name: move_cursor_down_one_row
description: Moves the grid cursor forward by one row of six cells when that stays inside the thirty-cell grid, then redraws the highlight.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1744
name: move_cursor_back_seven_cells
description: Moves the grid cursor back by seven cells unless the cell carries one of two marker values, then redraws the old and new highlights.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1766
name: move_cursor_back_five_cells
description: Moves the grid cursor back by five cells unless the cell carries one of two marker values, then redraws the old and new highlights.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:178E
name: move_cursor_forward_five_cells
description: Moves the grid cursor forward by five cells unless the cell carries one of two marker values, then redraws the old and new highlights.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:17B6
name: move_cursor_forward_seven_cells
description: Moves the grid cursor forward by seven cells unless the cell carries one of two marker values, then redraws the old and new highlights.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:17E4
name: select_cell_on_confirm
description: In mode zero, runs a check on the highlighted cell and on success records the selection, sets the state byte to escape and decrements the chosen slot's counter when it is non-zero.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:182E
name: apply_cell_action_by_mode
description: Runs a mode-specific check on the highlighted cell, using a range of two and then five for mode two and modes three and four with a range of ten, and sets the state byte to escape when the action succeeds.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:1860
name: apply_mode_three_four_action
description: For modes three and four, runs a check against a range of ten on the highlighted cell and, when it passes, draws the cell and sets the state byte to escape.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:18CC
name: compare_cell_stat_pair_action
description: For mode five, runs a check on the highlighted cell and compares two stored sixteen-bit values of the selected slot, setting the state to escape when the first is lower than the second.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:2:191C
